literal_meaning: তালার কাঠি নাড়া (to stir or manipulate the bolt/handle of a lock)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার ব্যবসায় কলকাঠি নাড়ে, কেউ জানে না তার পরিকল্পনা।
example_sentences_in_english: He pulls the strings in his business without anyone knowing his plans.
Many people work behind the scenes in politics.
history: This idiom likely originates from traditional wooden locks (kholkaathi) in rural Bengal, where secretly manipulating the internal wooden bolt allowed unauthorized access or control, symbolizing covert operations.
note: The idiom reflects everyday rural life in Bengal with traditional locking mechanisms.
